settingHint: Turning repeated rounds off prevents new rounds. It keeps existing rounds, ratings and revealed results.
settingsUncertain: The settings change could not be confirmed. Check the current settings before changing them again.
checkError: Could not verify the current collection. Try checking again.
descriptionHint: Up to 240 characters after removing outer whitespace. It will appear as written.
invalid: Enter a valid description of up to 240 characters.
unavailable: Could not start a new round here.
roundUncertain: Round creation could not be confirmed. Check the collection’s rounds before trying again.
roundChecked: Rounds were refreshed. This list does not identify the original request. You can explicitly retry the same request.
conflict: This round request conflicts with an existing request. No new round was confirmed.
leaveUncertain: The operation may already have taken effect. Leaving does not cancel it.
busy: Wait for the round operation to finish.
